item.title: Puka Nacua's suspension won't cost him any games, but the NFL's warning is clear
item.description: Nacua will serve his three-game ban while on injured reserve, yet the league's threat of banishment puts the star wide receiver on notice.
item.media:description: Puka Nacua, who is currently on injured reserve, was suspended three games for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.

item.title: Puka Nacua has knee surgery, likely out for season in latest setback for Rams
item.description: On Thursday the NFL announced Nacua would be suspended three games for violating the league’s personal conduct policy.
item.media:description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua will miss a couple months, coach Sean McVay said.
